out_items.name: No bare hand contact with ready-to-eat food, or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed

violations.title: Minimize Bare Hand/Arm Contact with Non-RTE Foods
violations.observation: Observed employee take a portion of broccoli with bare hands and put in wok for cooking.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall minimize bare hand and arm contact with exposed food that is NOT in a ready-to-eat food. Use a food scoop or utensils that are designed with handles to minimize bare hand contact. EDUCATED CFM ON WHY STAFF SHOULD USE UTENSIL WITH RAW BROCCOLI AND OTHER VEGETABLES.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The 3-comp sink faucet was observed to be leaking.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: The handsink basin across from cookline is slow to drain.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair.

out_items.name: Garbage and refuse properly disposed, facilities maintained

violations.title: Storage Areas/Receptacles, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: The grease disposal container located outside the facility was observed with a broken lid.
violations.corrective_action: Storage areas, enclosures, and receptacles for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be maintained in good repair.

violations.title: Refuse Areas & Enclosures Maintained Clean
violations.observation: Area that houses trash compactor outside the facility was not observed clean.
violations.corrective_action: A storage area and enclosure for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be maintained free of unnecessary items and kept clean.
